name: build-pipeline-non-graph-artifacts
body: The build-toolchain pins live in artifacts the code graph does not model — `.github/workflows/release.yml` (YAML) and the split `Formula/apg-*.rb` (Ruby) — so no implemented-by edge can target them. This note is the durable record that the plan, not the code graph, owns their edits; `rust.build_script_build` (build.rs) is the graph-visible half of the pipeline.
